source_policy: research/capital_quality/protocol.json plus protocol-clarifications.json and pinned native strategy
arm_selection: All five predeclared arms; no selection by July outcomes or holdout observations.

initial_state.note: Fresh matched cash at actual freeze; differs from July continuation from June residual inventory.

universe.extra_snapshot_pairs: Provenance/discovery only, never admitted to this comparison.
universe.missing_pair_policy: Keep the fixed identity in the audit, mark missing/untradeable/gapped; never silently remove to improve results.
universe.first_evaluation_bar: First full 5m candle whose start is at or after the actual financial/source freeze.
universe.causality: Fixed universe membership was known before freeze. Use actual completed candles only; no later winners/listings/status snapshot may select earlier trades.

warmup.source: Bounded first public 48h raw OHLC pages before freeze; separately labelled historical warmup, excluded from holdout return.
warmup.tuning: Forbidden; warmup initializes causal buffers only.
warmup.missing_history: Deny predicates requiring unavailable exact history; never forward-fill or extend historical lookback after observing outcomes.

timing.execution: Historical 5m paper model, no orderbook fills or 30-second execution claim.

accounting: equity = initial cash + realized P&L + open P&L
Parked-source basis and pending claims counted exactly
reports_after_close: Sparse bars, capture failures, delayed collection and stale marks
All five arms, including failed/inactive/inconclusive arms

execution_readiness.financial_rules_and_initial_conditions: Frozen now, before prospective market outcomes.
execution_readiness.future_adapter: Must independently reproduce the pinned native planners/economics and exact fresh-cash initial state; no new predicate/parameter changes using holdout outcomes.
execution_readiness.july_runner_limit: Pinned July runner hydrates June residual inventory and restored1898 assumptions; it is not executable as the fresh2000 holdout runner.
execution_readiness.mutable_native_imports: Forbidden; resolve only the exact external archive/member pins before future execution.
